text:
A man, attached to an elastic cord, jumps from a platform. He falls 60m before starting to rise.
The length of the unextended cord is 30m.
The diagrams show four successive stages in his fall.
In which position is elastic (strain) energy and kinetic energy present?
A
B
C
D
30m
45m
60m
subject: Physics
